description: Figure 1 displays a line plot illustrating the similarity of Hidden State Activations (HSAs) across all layers within the Qwen1.5-1.8B model, comparing four language pairs: English-English (en&en), English-Spanish (en&es), English-Bengali (en&bn), and Bengali-Greek (bn&hi). The x-axis represents the layer index, ranging from 0 to 21 in integer increments, indicating the position within the model's architecture. The y-axis represents the similarity score, which is a cosine similarity value ranging from 0 to 1, with tick marks at regular intervals. The plot contains four distinct lines, each corresponding to one language pair. The en&en line, shown in red, remains consistently high across all layers, peaking at approximately 0.98 in layer 0 and declining slightly to around 0.96 in layer 21. The en&es line, shown in blue, starts at approximately 0.85 in layer 0 and shows a slight decline to about 0.82 in layer 21. The en&bn line, shown in green, begins at approximately 0.78 in layer 0 and decreases to about 0.72 in layer 21. The bn&hi line, shown in orange, starts at approximately 0.75 in layer 0 and declines to about 0.68 in layer 21. All lines exhibit a general downward trend across the layers, with the en&en pair maintaining the highest similarity throughout.
